content.short: Turbos is a hyper-efficient CLMM DEX on Sui backed by Mysten Labs, offering optimized concentrated liquidity.
content.description: Turbos Finance is a leading decentralized exchange and liquidity hub built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide users with a professional-grade trading experience. Developed in collaboration with Mysten Labs and backed by Jump Crypto, the platform utilizes a Concentrated Liquidity Market Maker model that allows providers to allocate capital within specific price ranges. This approach significantly increases fee capture for providers and reduces slippage for traders. Leveraging Sui's high throughput, Turbos delivers a responsive venue for asset exchange.
content.meta: Turbos offers professional-grade concentrated liquidity trading and high-speed AMM pools on Sui. Discover Turbos and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
